items.author: Arseny Kapoulkine
items.changes: Used unchanged.

items.what: js-aruco2 2.0.0: cv.js and aruco.js (ar/js/vendor/js-aruco2.js)
items.author: Juan Mellado (js-aruco), Damiano Falcioni (js-aruco2); based on ArUco (BSD) and OpenCV (BSD)
items.licence: MIT (+ BSD for the ArUco/OpenCV parts)
items.changes: Wrapped as an ES module; the two big built-in dictionaries removed; our 12 codes registered; DUET replaces its grey, threshold and cell-reading steps with faster ones (js/detect.js). posit1/posit2/svd.js are not included (their references point at LGPL / Numerical Recipes code); DUET has its own pose solver (js/pose.js).

items.what: The 4×4 marker codes (12 of the 50 in DICT_4X4_50)
items.author: ArUco / OpenCV
items.changes: 12 codes chosen so that any two differ in at least 6 cells under every turn (js/markers.js).

items.what: Least-squares red-cyan anaglyph colour matrices
items.author: Eric Dubois, "A projection method to generate anaglyph stereo images", ICASSP 2001
items.changes: Our own shader in js/anaglyph.js uses the published matrices.
